data.gender_notes: Shivprasad is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who receives the blessings of Lord Shiva. The name Shivprasad carries the meaning “Shiva's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shivprasad usually hope their child will grow to embody shiva's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Shivprasad belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shiva's gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivprasad total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Shivprasad" is rooted in Hindu culture and religion, carrying the reverence for the god Shiva. Shiva is one of the most important deities in Hinduism, known as the "Destroyer of Evil and the God of Regeneration." This name symbolizes the connection between an individual and Lord Shiva, implying a deep sense of devotion and respect for the god.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Shivprasad" signifies receiving the blessings and grace of Lord Shiva, symbolizing the profound spiritual journey and path of devotion. Shiva is known as the giver of boons and blessings, and the name serves as a constant reminder of the transformative power of faith and devotion. It signifies the profound inner peace, enlightenment, and wisdom that come from deeply connecting with the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shivprasad: Receiving the grace and blessings of Shiva, the destroyer of ignorance and negativity. Embracing the divine power of transformation within.

historical_references.reference: Shivprasad was the name of a Maratha king who ruled the princely state of Jadhavgarh from 1672 to 1752. He is remembered for his military prowess, particularly his victories against the Mughals.
historical_references.context: Maratha Empire, Jadhavgarh Princely State, Military conquests against Mughals

historical_references.reference: Shivprasad was also the name of a renowned Hindu scholar, philosopher and poet of the 13th century who is best known for his work 'Shivshakti Stotra'. He was a contemporary of the great poet Sant Tukaram and is considered an important figure in the Bhagavad-Purana tradition.
historical_references.context: Hindu scholarly tradition, Bhagavad-Purana, Contemporary of Sant Tukaram

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Shivprasad has gained popularity in modern times across various platforms. On Instagram, it is seen in the context of yoga and spirituality, where many profiles with this name share inspiring quotes, practices, and experiences related to Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction and transformation. On LinkedIn, professionals with this name are associated with the tech industry, particularly software engineering, data analysis, and IT services. Lastly, on Twitter, the name Shivprasad is often used in conversations surrounding food and beverage, particularly Indian cuisine, as it is a common name in the Indian subcontinent.
